summary: Revise at 6.2 (round 1: 6.0, Caiman: 7, ship: 7.5). One round remains. The ring still names a rose at 300 px, and every blocking gate is green and checked against report.json and verification.json. The lost-wax wall census is still recorded as FAILED, on both the export and draft builds. It lists 5 real walls of 0.03 to 0.14 mm², one as thin as 0.056 mm, so under review.md the verdict is an automatic revise whatever the art scores. Of the six punch items from round 1, none is fully closed. The hip moved the most, but the wrong way for the brief. The plain can is now a turned, stepped 'flying saucer': a coned skirt, a flat ledge and an inner bezel. It is still lathe CAD, not an urn-shaped fruit. Its five sepals are still round tubes with blunt or flat-cut ends, standing on the ledge like spider legs. The garnet is darker in stones.json but still renders as stepped facet bands, and at face size it is close to the ruby's raspberry. The bloom (item 2) is unchanged. Its petals are extruded slabs with vertical walls and a crumpled-foil skin, the smooth heart-collet rim still rings the ruby, there is no one-way spiral and no reflexed outer row. The leaflets now have a cup and a centre fold. But their teeth are still stair-stepped polylines on vertical walls, the loft sections show as bands, and the rachis still ends in a flat-cut tube. The prickles got worse. They are now two tight rows of five blunt, rounded pegs that straddle the band's horizontal midline (θ −14° to 16° and 168° to 197°), graded only 1.0 to 0.72. In side.png and contact-300 they read as caterpillar legs or a comb, not hooked rose prickles. The three stem nodes read as hairline spurs, there is no cane striation, the bypass crossing is still hidden under the bloom, and a seam step shows near 6 o'clock in reverse.png. Below Kraken (7.0) and near Corvus's round 2. Reaching 7.5 in one round needs the bloom, hip and prickles all rebuilt, so the punch list puts those first.
strengths: Still names a rose at 300 px without a caption: an open many-petalled head with a red heart, a leaf spray and thorns (hero-300, face-300, contact-300).
Clear large / medium / small hierarchy on the face: the bloom about 13 mm, the hip about 8 mm, then the leaf and prickles. The ruby heart is a strong focal point.
One theme from face to palm, with nothing scattered: bloom and hip on the face, leaf and prickle rows on the shoulders, a plain stem with nodes at the palm, a smooth bore.
Leaflets have gained a visible cup and a centre fold, so they are no longer flat slabs (leaf-close).
The hip's base now flares into the arm. No dark gap shows under it as in round 1 (hip-close).

Every blocking gate is green with clean numbers: 0 degenerates and 0 crossings on the ring, the pattern and all made parts; empty notes; 0 DFM; 2/2 stones with 0 metal inside; thinnest field wall 2.01 mm; 1.31 M triangles; cold reload identical; 1 design.set patch; template 258 KB, down from 296 KB.

checklist.item: One theme face to palm, nothing scattered
checklist.reason: Bloom and hip on the face, leaf and prickles on the shoulders, plain noded stem at the palm, smooth bore (palm.png, reverse.png). It is all one rose stem.

checklist.item: Reads as its plant at 300 px without the caption
checklist.reason: The bloom plus the leaf spray name a rose in hero-300 and face-300. Marginal again: the hip reads as a stone in a spiked turned cup, and the prickle rows read as combs or legs. The read rests on the bloom alone.

checklist.item: Figurative motifs have true outlines, crisp, no combing, smearing or stair-steps
checklist.reason: In leaf-close the leaflet teeth are still stair-stepped polylines with vertical side walls, and the loft sections band across the faces. In bloom-close the petal rims are faceted, the walls vertical and the faces smeared by crumple noise. The hip sepals show pinched, lumpy kinks near their tips (hip-close). stamps.count is 0.

checklist.item: Stones sit in made settings, visible, coloured as the plant's fruit or buds
checklist.reason: Both stones sit in made bezels and are visible. The hip setting is a stepped turned disc (coned skirt, ledge, inner bezel), not a fruit. Its five sepals are round tubes with blunt or flat-cut ends standing outside the bezel, not lens-section sepals arching over the dome. The garnet (tint [0.28, 0.03, 0.05]) still renders as stepped facet bands (hip-close, stones.png), and in face.png it is still close to the ruby. The heart collet's plain rim still shows round the ruby (bloom-close, face.png).

checklist.item: No flat, blocky or mechanical CAD; forms are sculpted
checklist.reason: The petals are still extruded profiles with vertical walls. The hip is a lathe-turned stepped disc. The sepals and prickles are constant-section rounded tubes and pegs. The rachis ends in a flat-cut tube. A seam step shows near 6 o'clock in reverse.png.

checklist.item: Factory stock keeps its hard wall-to-face angles
checklist.reason: Not applicable: a procedural Bypass HighDome round stem, no factory stock.

checklist.item: A silhouette distinct from the other Vepres rings
checklist.reason: No other Vepres ring is built. The off-centre bloom and hip, with side prickle rows, is its own silhouette. The bypass crossing that should define it is still hidden under the bloom (bare-vs-finished, side.png).

checklist.item: Large, medium and small forms; density and legibility at least Caiman's
checklist.reason: The face is dense, but the lower half of the band (palm.png, side.png) is a polished tube with three hairline nodes. The prickles are one size of blunt peg (grade 1.0 to 0.72) packed in a comb. Caiman works its whole visible body with legible scales. This ring works about a third.

punch_list.zone: Bloom at θ 97°: 'Heart collet', 'Petal ring 1-4', 'Receptacle' (round 1 item 2, not done)
punch_list.change: Rebuild the petals as lofted or swept cupped shells: at least 0.9 mm thick at the base, tapering to a 0.5 mm rounded rim, with no vertical side wall. Wrap 3-4 ring-1 petals in a one-way spiral that rises 1.5 mm over the collet rim and hides it. Rotate each ring 1-3 petals the same way. Reflex ring 4 out and down 20-35° below the bloom plane, with curled-back tips. Replace the crumple noise with 2-3 broad dried folds per petal (wavelength at least 1.5 mm, amplitude at most 0.3 mm).
punch_list.acceptance: bloom-close shows no vertical extruded petal edge, no faceted rim and no smooth collet metal round the ruby. The inner petals spiral visibly one way. In side.png the outer row droops below the inner rows. In face-300, with the hip and prickles covered, the head alone reads as a rose.

punch_list.zone: Lost-wax wall census: the 5 real-wall points listed under gates
punch_list.change: Add a part name to every wall_census.real_walls entry, as census_note promises. Then fix each zone to at least 0.8 mm across, or fuse it: the two upper-bloom zones (-5.29, 12.22, 4.05) and (-0.23, 12.36, 5.79), by merging overlapping petal pairs; (-4.58, 14.17, -3.33), a 0.056 mm sliver unchanged since round 1; and the two prickle-row zones (13.21, -3.90, 0.19) and (-12.95, -4.54, -0.33), by opening or fusing the gap between neighbouring prickle bases.
punch_list.acceptance: report.json wall_census.real_walls is empty on both the export and draft builds, and the census gate reads pass: true. Every other gate stays green.

punch_list.zone: Hip on arm B, θ 38°: 'Hip collet', 'Hip urn', 'Hip's dried sepal' / 'Hip's dried crown', garnet (round 1 item 1, partly done)
punch_list.change: Drop the stepped disc (coned skirt plus flat ledge plus inner bezel). Sweep one smooth urn profile: a 2.5 mm neck at the stem, swelling to about 7.4 mm, then closing inward over the garnet's girdle as its own bezel lip, with no horizontal ledge. Rebuild the five sepals as flat lens sections (0.7 x 0.5 mm, twist 60°, end_scale 0.4 to a point) that spring from the urn lip itself and arch 1.0-1.5 mm over the dome before curling outward, not as round tubes standing outside the bezel. Tessellate the cabochon reference mesh at least 4x finer. Move the garnet tint browner, toward [0.22, 0.04, 0.03].
punch_list.acceptance: In hip-close the hip silhouette is one continuous convex-to-concave curve from the neck to the lip, with no step or ledge. All 5 sepals are flat, end in points, and grow from the lip. The garnet dome shows no stepped bands. In face-300 the garnet reads browner and darker than the ruby, and the hip alone, with the bloom covered, reads as a rose hip.

punch_list.zone: Prickle rows 'Prickles down arm A' (θ −14° to 16°) and 'Prickles down arm B' (θ 168° to 197°) (round 1 item 5, regressed)
punch_list.change: Replace the blunt pegs with rose prickles: a broad elongated base about 2.0 x 1.2 mm along the stem, flaring into the stem with a fillet, tapering to a fine point (tip radius at most 0.15 mm), hooked 30-40° down the stem. Space them at least 1.5 base-lengths apart, not packed in a comb, and alternate them over the crest. Grade them 1.0 to 0.5. Move arm A's row to θ 60° to 15° and arm B's to θ 125° to 170°, so nothing sits below the horizontal midline.
punch_list.acceptance: In side.png each prickle shows a broad base, a sharp hooked point and a clear size grade, with stem visible between neighbours. No prickle lies below the midline in side.png or hero-300. In contact-300 the rows no longer read as combs or legs.

punch_list.zone: Leaf on arm A: 'Leaf, terminal / upper lateral / lower lateral leaflet', 'Leaf, rachis' (round 1 item 4, partly done)
punch_list.change: Keep the new cup and midrib. Resample the toothed outline at least 8 points per tooth (9-12 teeth per side, 0.25 mm deep), so the rim is a smooth curve. Raise the loft section count so the faces do not band, and round the rim to 0.5 mm, with no vertical wall. Blend the rachis into the stem with a petiole base, not a flat-cut tube end.
punch_list.acceptance: leaf-close shows smooth toothed rims with no stair-steps, no section banding and no vertical wall. The rachis has no flat cut end.

punch_list.zone: Band: arm crossing θ 60-120°, seam near 6 o'clock, plain stem θ 220-320° (round 1 item 6, partly done)
punch_list.change: Open 1.0-1.5 mm of visible air between arm A and arm B under the bloom and hip, so the bypass shows. Fair the seam step near 6 o'clock in reverse.png. Make the three nodes read as low swollen rings, 0.2-0.3 mm proud and about 1 mm long, not hairline spurs. Add fine longitudinal cane striations (0.08-0.12 mm) along the plain stem.
punch_list.acceptance: In side.png and bare-vs-finished the two arms read as separate stems passing each other. reverse.png shows no seam step. palm.png shows cane texture and swollen nodes, with no motifs.
